description: This file is a shell script designed to automate the restarting, rebuilding, signing, and launching of the OpenClaw application on macOS. It manages processes, handles signing keys, packages the app, installs launch agents, and verifies the app is running.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: run_step
methods.description: Logs the given step label and executes a command, failing on error.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes the lock directory if it exists to clean up resources.

methods.name: acquire_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory for synchronizing restart processes, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: check_signing_keys
methods.description: Checks macOS code signing identities for valid signing keys.

methods.name: kill_all_openclaw
methods.description: Kills all running instances of the OpenClaw application and associated processes.

methods.name: stop_launch_agent
methods.description: Stops the launch agent for OpenClaw.
